The '''Teonsqua River''' was a river located within the [[Chekkoo Province]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. The headwaters of the river were located within the [[Ekloska Hills]], and the river ran through the Chekkoo province before emptying into a swamp south of the province.
